felicis._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md §8). Felicis's rows arrive from six renderings of the same book -- the 2006-2007 felicisventures.com table, the 2008-2010 ASP.NET cards, the 2011-2019 WordPress logo wall, /portfolio-item/, /company/ and the current /companies/ Next.js pages -- plus Form D issuers filing under a REGISTERED name no listing ever used. The registered-name class is the interesting one here: three of them arrived as apparently-new members carrying a current Felicis partner as Director of record, which is the a16z unannounced-deal pattern, and each resolved instead to a company the base already had under its trading name. Canonical = the firm's current rendering where the company is still listed, else the last rendering. (A justin-tv -> twitch entry was drafted and removed: build-company-base.py's own name-variant pass already collapses the pair, so no slug `justin-tv` survives to merge.)

merges.reason: Atlas Labs, Inc. is the registered entity of Atlas Health (Seattle). Its Form D (0001790561-22-000001, $41,499,962 sold) carries SUNDEEP PEECHU as Director, in tenure; the round is the $40M Series A of January 2022 that Felicis LED. Same company, two names. [https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20220125005225/en/Atlas-Health-Raises-%2440M-Series-A-to-Expand-AI-Powered-Patient-Advocacy-Solution]

PRM Solutions, Inc. files 'dba Proton.ai' (Cambridge MA). Its Form D (0001849278-22-000001, $24,041,802) carries NIKI PEZESHKI as Director, in tenure. The base row `proton` is the same company. NOTE: the Wikidata layer put `proton` in Ukraine, which is Proton AG, the Swiss privacy company -- a different entity entirely, and one of the single-token joins ruling R5 demotes. [https://www.intelligence360.news/cambridge-massachusetts-based-prm-solutions-dba-proton-ai-is-raising-24041802-00-in-new-equity-investment/]
